title: webapi.call
description: Call an exact approved WebAPI as the profile grant owner. JSON returns the DSM envelope; raw (since 0.12.1) requires profile raw_max_bytes and returns content_type, size, sha256 and base64 body or private staging handle. An optional upload (profile upload_max_bytes, at most 96000 bytes) injects App-staged bytes as one base64 param. Never retried.

response_type.description: Defaults to json. Raw requires an explicitly approved raw_max_bytes profile.

upload.description: Inject App-staged bytes as the base64 value of one param. Requires an approved profile upload_max_bytes (1..96000); not combined with raw; param must not be in params.

params.description: JSON API arguments, at most 32768 encoded bytes; authentication, runner and dispatch keys are forbidden.
